ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, April 17, 2017 and to business minors on Monday, April 24, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Technical Systems Management students on Monday, May 1, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 20 seats reserved for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, September 1, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
